chats.empty: No chats yet. Select + to start one.

thread.noteP2P: Direct chat between devices with unaudited custom encryption. Each device deletes its copy after 72 hours.
attach.badImage: Unsupported image. Send it as a document.
loc.title: Share your location
ctc.title: Share a contact
poll.title: New poll
ev.title: New event
ev.name: Event title
link.loaded: Loaded from {domain}, which sees your IP address.
contacts.title: Contacts
contacts.empty: No contacts yet. Use Connect to add someone.
contacts.qrNote: Anyone who scans this can ask to connect. You approve each request.
contacts.safety: Compare this number on both devices. If it matches, nobody tampered with the pairing.
contacts.removeAsk: Remove this contact and its chat?
contacts.qrBad: This is not a Q7 contact QR code.
connect.title: Connect
connect.codeNote: An address, not a password. You approve every request.
connect.relayOff: Relay off. Only QR codes and invite files work.
connect.hint: Show this to the other device, then scan or paste its reply.
connect.pastePh: Paste an invitation or reply (starts with Q7:)
scan.noCamera: Camera needs HTTPS. Paste the text or import the file instead.
scan.denied: Camera permission denied or no camera found.
err.relayOff: Code connections are off. Turn on the relay in Settings, or use a QR code.
err.relayDown: No relay is reachable right now.
err.noReply: No reply. The other person must have Q7 Chat open.
err.link: Could not connect. Some networks block direct connections.
err.invalid: This invitation is invalid or expired.
err.save: This browser is not saving messages (private browsing?).
set.title: Settings
set.name: Display name
set.encNote: Custom encryption, not independently audited. Compare safety numbers with contacts.
set.relayOn: Connect by code through public relays
set.relayNote: Relays see your IP address, never message content.
set.exportWarn: The export is not encrypted. Anyone with the file can read it.
set.wipeAsk: Delete all chats, contacts, files and your Q7 code? This cannot be undone.
set.expiry: Messages are removed after 72 hours. Screenshots and copies on other devices are not affected.
welcome.title: Notes to self
welcome.text: A local chat, stored in this browser only. Messages are deleted after 72 hours.
clear.ask: Delete all messages in this chat?
info.blockedNote: This contact can't message or call you.
top.appsEmpty: A bit empty in here… New Q7 apps will appear here.
set.notif.note: Get a system notification for new messages while the tab is in the background.
set.notif.denied: Notification permission is denied. Allow this site in your browser settings.
set.a11y.motionNote: Minimises transitions and animations if you are motion-sensitive.
set.restrict.note: Connection requests from people not in your contacts are silently ignored. Turn it off temporarily when adding someone new.
set.restrict.blocked: Blocked contacts: {n}. Manage them in the Contacts tab.
rail.dmNone: No direct messages yet. Add someone from Connect.
mentions.title: Mentions
mentions.none: No mentions yet. When someone writes @yourname it shows up here.
starred.title: Starred chats
starred.none: Chats you star collect here. Star them from the chat menu.
spaces.title: Spaces
spaces.empty: Spaces group your contacts like small communities. Create one.
spaces.name: Space name
spaces.noMembers: No members in this space yet.
spaces.deleteAsk: Delete this space? Your contacts are not removed.
group.name: Group name
group.leaveAsk: Leave this group? You will stop receiving its messages.
group.big: In groups, attachments travel over relays and are limited to 150 KB.
thread.noteGroup: Encrypted group between members. Every message is sealed per recipient and each device deletes its copy after 72 hours.
lock.intro: Your identity is locked on this device. Enter your password to continue.
lock.note: The password never leaves this device; your identity keys are sealed with PBKDF2 + AES-GCM. Message content stays in plain text on the device.
lock.removeAsk: Removing the password stores the identity unencrypted on this device again.
lock.short: Password must be at least 4 characters.
lock.totpIntro: Add a second step with Google Authenticator, Aegis or any similar app; a 6-digit code is asked when unlocking.
lock.totpScan: Scan with your app, or type the key manually:
device.title: Device hand-over
device.intro: Move this identity to another browser or device: same code, same contacts. The new device knocks on this device's door using your code below; compare the safety codes and approve.
device.windowOpen: Pairing window is open — the new device can enter your code (2 minutes).
device.safety: Safety code — must be identical on both screens:
device.sent: Identity handed over. The new device will reload in a few seconds.
device.waiting: Connecting… waiting for approval on the old device.
device.checkCode: Compare the safety code with the old device:
device.replaceWarn: Adopting replaces this device's current identity, contacts and settings.
